_meta.purpose: Step 7 router. After the engine produces opportunities, each surviving domain is classified by SITE TYPE and routed to ONE action. Email is only for 'email_outreach'. Newsletters and directories become report sections, not emails.
_meta.production_note: site_type + has_paid_option + vertical_fit are determined by fetching the site (homepage + /about + the signal pages below) and having the AI classify. The known_sites map seeds the first report and acts as a cache; unknown domains route to 'needs_review' until classified.

email_outreach.label: Direct outreach — ask for publication / contribution
email_outreach.email_angle: Propose a contributor article, expert quote, or being added to a relevant list.

report_newsletter.label: Paid newsletters — consider buying a slot
report_newsletter.note: Self-serve or rate-card sponsorship. Report lists each with its advertise/sponsor page.

report_directory.label: Directories — self-list (no email)
report_directory.note: Free or self-service submission. Report lists each with its submit page.

reasons.commercial_blog: A product/company blog. They won't link to a competitor; the link was their own content.
reasons.tier1_too_expensive: Top-tier mainstream press. Paid placement unrealistic.
reasons.incidental_noise: Passed numeric filters but the link is incidental; not a real target.

needs_review.note: Ambiguous on automated signals. Held for a human glance before routing.

classification_signals._comment: URL paths the classifier probes on each candidate site to infer the action.

known_sites._comment: Seed/cache of classified domains. Add entries as you classify, so future runs skip re-probing. Examples below show the shape — replace with sites in your niche.
